purpose: Prevent dimensional concepts from being silently collapsed during implementation.
rules: A dimensional system may not be reinterpreted as another dimensional system without an explicit architecture decision.
Cardinality alone does not prove implementation.
A node/agent/module existing in a registry does not imply completion, achievement, financial value, ownership or external-world realization.
Narrative or speculative infrastructure must be represented as SIMULATION_ONLY or DESIGNED until independently verifiable infrastructure exists.
